'''''Amberdawn''''' was a popular morning news com filmed in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] and aired across [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNets]]. Its rival show was hosted by [[Brookish Boon/Legends|Brookish Boon]].
